entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
The petitioner is before this Court seeking following prayer:
"b) Refer the Crime No.112/2022 of Chelur Police Station, Gubbi Circle, Tumkur District, registered for the offences punishable under Sections 494, 506, 34, 420,
498A, 323 and 324 of I.P.C. for further investigation to C.I.D. (Criminal Investigation Department) of Karnataka Police for further investigation against the accused/respondents No.3 to 5 or to any other higher police officer other than the 1st respondent."
2. In respect of aforesaid prayer, the petition under Section 482 Cr.P.C. is not maintainable.

sentences.text: Therefore, reserving liberty to the petitioner to avail of such remedy, as available in law, the petition stands disposed.
